Updates to your Governance Forum 


**Your Representatives** has been added to the categories

To complete the request from Thursday's community meeting regarding the dedicated page for selecting delegates.  

1. This is the page where citizens list their aspirations.
2. Those seeking indirect governance can would view and decide who to trust as their spokesperson.


** Community Updates** to the categories

1. Lists the posts under “updates-community”
2. A place to review your weekly _EDG Community Updates_

The Category updates have been completed!  
Thread Migration for existing posts is actionable by the original author  

Special Thank you to Shankar for his assistance in communication with the CommonWealth team 

The next objectives for this tasks

**Governance Upgrades**
- ·Voting History displayed
- ·onChain Tags for Proposals
This submission is in a effort to unify our Governance page with the recent updates to our homepage. Feedback is always appreciated..
